turnout.notes: Connecticut EMS turnout rows use EV as registered/elector denominator and VV as voters checked. All rows are warning-required until EMS field semantics and Statement-of-Vote/EAC differences are reviewed. The July 6, 2026 Election History source review confirmed event 582 President town/vote-channel totals but found no event 582 voter-statistics rows or registered-voter denominator, so it does not replace EMS turnout.
